name: Orcus, Demon Prince of the Undead

traits.name: Special equipment
traits.text: Orcus wields its iconic rod, the Wand of Orcus.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: Orcus’s spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 28, +20 to hit with spell attacks). Orcus can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: * At will: animate dead, chill touch (17th level), detect magic * 7/day: create undead * 5/day: eyebite * 3/day each: circle of death, finger of death

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/day)
traits.text:
If Orcus fails a saving throw, it
can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Lord of the Grave
traits.text:
Orcus always casts animate dead or create undead at maximum level and without any restrictions. Creatures created by these spells remain under its control
indefinitely.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
Orcus has advantage on saving throws against spells
and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Orcus makes two Wand of Orcus attacks.

actions.name: Wand of Orcus
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +20 to hit, reach 5 ft., one
target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) bludgeoning damage and the target must make
a DC 17 Charisma saving throw, dropping to 0 hit points on failure, or, on
a success, the target takes 21 (6d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +20 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) poison damage.

actions.name: Aura of Death
actions.text:
Each non-undead creature that starts its turn within 20
feet of Orcus takes 17 (5d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Aura of Enfeeblement (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text:
Black beams of negative
energy surround Orcus in a 20-foot radius centered on it. Each creature in
this area must make a DC 24 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the
target deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength for 1
minute. A weakened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each
of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target’s saving
throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to Orcus’s Aura of Enfeeblement for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.text:
Orcus magically teleports, along with any equipment it is
wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
